name: Temperature
definition: Air temperature at 2 meters and land surface temperature describe different parts of the heat system. Satellite LST is the surface skin temperature, not the air temperature.
process: Desert albedo, irrigation and urban surfaces can change heat differently. A regional trend alone does not identify an urban heat island or its cause.
caution: Do not merge MERRA-2 air temperature and MODIS LST into one time series.

name: Humidity
definition: Specific humidity is water vapor mass per mass of moist air. Relative humidity is the percentage of saturation and depends on temperature.
process: Moisture transport from the Gulf and Red Sea interacts with warming and coastal development. Relative humidity may fall even as water vapor increases.
caution: AIRS humidity is vertically resolved: choose an explicit pressure level. Never average pressure levels together.

products.needs_selection: Select a documented relative humidity field and pressure level from product metadata.

name: Precipitation
definition: IMERG combines satellite precipitation estimates with gauge information. Monthly precipitation rate is not a monthly accumulated total.
process: Winter storms, mountain rain, and summer monsoon moisture affect the Middle East differently. Compare matching seasons rather than assuming a global trend.
caution: Convert rates to totals only with documented units and time bounds. NASA POWER precipitation is not IMERG and is not substituted here.

name: Wind
definition: Wind vectors describe eastward (U10M) and northward (V10M) flow at 10 meters. Speed of the monthly mean vector differs from mean wind speed.
process: Shamal winds transport dust across Iraq and the Arabian Peninsula. Seasonal wind direction and strength can evolve independently.
caution: Direction is circular. Never run a linear trend on compass degrees. Native vector speed is sqrt(U² + V²); direction is meteorological 'from'.

starter.label: NASA POWER / MERRA-2 mean wind speed (not vector speed)

name: Dust loading
definition: Dust column mass is the modeled mass of dust above a square meter. Aerosol optical depth describes light extinction by particles throughout the atmospheric column.
process: Shamal winds, soil moisture and exposed sediments influence regional dust. All-aerosol AOD is not dust composition or a storm count.
caution: Monthly AOD or dust mass cannot determine storm frequency. Event counts require a validated daily threshold and completeness rule.

starter.label: NASA MERRA2-GMI monthly dust optical depth

name: Air quality
definition: PM2.5 is the mass concentration of particles smaller than 2.5 micrometers. The public measurement is NASA MERRA2-GMI reconstructed bottom-layer PM2.5 in micrograms per cubic meter; it is a model replay, not a street-level sensor reading. OMI NO₂ is a separate column measurement.
process: Shipping, urban emissions, oil and gas activity, transported pollution, and dust may influence different measurements.
caution: PM2.5 is not NO₂ or chemical composition. The NASA bottom-layer field uses kg/m³, converted by ×1,000,000,000 to µg/m³. Grid-scale monthly means do not describe hourly personal exposure.

name: Low clouds
definition: Low-cloud fraction describes the fraction of a grid cell covered by low clouds. Fog is near-surface cloud that reduces visibility and needs separate validation.
process: Cool winter nights, marine moisture and boundary-layer stability influence fog risk along the Gulf coast.
caution: A cloud-fraction trend is not a fog-frequency trend. Do not infer visibility or fog events from a monthly mean.

name: Water storage
definition: GRACE measures changes in total water storage, including groundwater, soil moisture, surface water and snow. GLDAS estimates land-surface water components.
process: Irrigation, reservoir operations, drought and abstraction can change the Tigris–Euphrates basin water balance.
caution: GRACE is not groundwater alone or a reservoir water-level gauge. Groundwater estimates require component subtraction and uncertainty propagation. Mission gaps stay missing.

products.resolution: mascons; gridded spacing is not independent resolution
products.needs_selection: Requested identifier has no exact NASA CMR match. Choose the explicitly labeled active RL06.3 V4 alternative; never silently replace versions.

products.resolution: mascons; output grid is not independent resolution
products.version_note: Explicit active alternative to the unmatched requested RL06.1_V2 identifier. Reference baseline and corrections must be read from source attributes.

starter.label: NASA GSFC GRACE / GRACE-FO land water storage

name: Sea-level mass
definition: Sea surface height anomalies measure departures from a reference surface. Jason along-track observations and SWOT swaths have different sampling and processing.
process: Thermal expansion, winds and circulation influence Gulf and Red Sea sea level. Tidal patterns require high-frequency tidal analysis, not a linear monthly trend.
caution: The public GRACE SLA metric measures the mass component of sea-level anomaly in equivalent water height. It excludes thermal expansion and is not total altimetric sea-surface height or tidal analysis. Jason / SWOT remain separate products.

products.needs_selection: Choose science-quality delayed-time Jason SSHA collection and field through CMR; operational OGDR is discovery only.
SWOT swath processing and documented quality-bit masking required; record too short for multi-decade analysis.

starter.label: NASA GSFC GRACE / GRACE-FO ocean mass

name: Ocean & surface heat
definition: OSCAR estimates near-surface ocean velocity from satellite observations and physical models. MODIS SST measures sea-surface skin temperature under clear-sky conditions.
process: Monsoon winds, exchange through the Strait of Hormuz and Bab el-Mandeb, and marine heat affect coastal ecosystems.
caution: The public metric is modeled surface skin temperature over both land and ocean. For marine thermal analysis select an offshore region; coastal cells can include land. It is not MODIS SST and does not measure currents. Authenticated OSCAR and MODIS products remain separate choices.

products.needs_selection: Verified CMR short name corrected from an invalid adapter identifier. Validate SST quality mask and native field units before enabling acquisition.

name: Lake water levels
definition: NASA Global Water Measurements monitors water-surface height changes at individual lake and reservoir ground-track locations. This is a feature observation, separate from regional GRACE water storage.
process: Rainfall, drought, inflow, evaporation and dam operation can raise or lower reservoir levels. A trend alone does not separate these causes.
caution: Select a monitored lake. Monthly values average the actual available satellite overpasses; missing observations remain missing. Referenced anomalies are not absolute lake depths. Ice, narrow crossings and mission-merger advisories must be reviewed in the source.

products.needs_selection: Public feature records are available in the monitored-lake selector.

name: Soil wetness
definition: Relative soil wetness in the root zone from NASA MERRA2-GMI monthly land diagnostics. This is a dimensionless modeled wetness, not groundwater storage.
process: Rain, evaporation and land processes can change soil wetness. Availability is limited to modeled land cells.
caution: Global locations, bounded study areas and native source resolution; published archive 1980–2019. This chemistry replay is not the supplied fixed-region 2000–2025 MERRA-2 study. Missing observations are not filled.

name: Topsoil wetness
definition: Relative soil wetness in the surface layer from NASA MERRA2-GMI monthly land diagnostics. This is a dimensionless modeled wetness, not groundwater storage.
process: Rain, evaporation and land processes can change soil wetness. Availability is limited to modeled land cells.
caution: Global locations, bounded study areas and native source resolution; published archive 1980–2019. This chemistry replay is not the supplied fixed-region 2000–2025 MERRA-2 study. Missing observations are not filled.

name: Precipitation rate · PRECTOT
definition: NASA MERRA2-GMI monthly prectot converted from kg/m²/s to mean precipitation rate in mm/day. It is distinct from the uploaded study’s monthly totals and the existing NASA POWER product.
process: Rainfall can vary differently across regions. PRECTOT and PRECTOTCORR remain separate fields.
caution: Global locations, bounded study areas and native source resolution; published archive 1980–2019. This chemistry replay is not the supplied fixed-region 2000–2025 MERRA-2 study. Missing observations are not filled.
metric_notice: NASA replay PRECTOT and PRECTOTCORR are identical in the audited Gulf and California records. These are rates, separate from the supplied study’s monthly totals.

definition: NASA MERRA2-GMI monthly prectotcorr converted from kg/m²/s to mean precipitation rate in mm/day. It is distinct from the uploaded study’s monthly totals and the existing NASA POWER product.
process: Rainfall can vary differently across regions. PRECTOT and PRECTOTCORR remain separate fields.

Missing observations are not filled. The audited Gulf and California PRECTOT and PRECTOTCORR records are identical; no difference is invented.
